name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Demand Marketing Specialist | Channel Ownership, Pipeline Generation & Funnel Optimization
summary: Demand generation practitioner who has owned an outbound and email channel end-to-end, from targeting and segmentation through appointment booking, at Solenzo, where 20+ automated workflows and a free-audit funnel enrolled 180+ businesses and generated qualified conversations. Builds and optimizes the full funnel personally: campaign targeting, sequencing, conversion tracking, and reporting, using GoHighLevel and HubSpot as the operating systems. Comfortable translating channel performance into the language sales teams act on, from a career spent split between building demand and closing it.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built segmented cold-email and outbound outreach engines in GoHighLevel (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect 'audit' workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.

Architected a complete marketing-automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, lead qualification, and appointment booking with confirmation, reminders, and no-show recovery.
Ran a free digital-footprint audit offer promoted through organic channel growth, enrolling 180+ businesses and converting a share to paying clients, tracked and reported end to end.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor channel and agent performance and continuously optimize results.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and coordinated with the implementation team on delivery.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
